veg.n: Prison gravy with mushroom and ricotta meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled. Meatballs can be rolled 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until all their liquid has gone and they are browned, then cool.
Soak the bread in the milk, then mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, egg, cheese, breadcrumbs, parsley, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt and pepper. Chill for 15 minutes.
Roll into 16 balls and brown gently in the rest of the olive oil, turning carefully. Lift out.
In the same pot gently cook the remaining garlic sliced razor thin and the onion, add the tomatoes and simmer for 45 minutes, then add the meatballs for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and meatballs.

veg.make_ahead: Wipe and trim the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; season and cook on the night

steps.text: Wipe the portobello mushrooms, trim the stems and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy pan until smoking.
Cook the mushrooms four at a time, gill side up first, pressing down with a spatula, about 4 minutes each side until browned and tender.
In the last minute add the butter and smashed garlic and spoon them over the mushrooms.
Rest for 2 minutes before serving.

veg.n: Mum's mushroom and white bean rice bake
veg.make_ahead: Brown the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; assemble with the rice, beans, stock and cream and bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the olive oil and butter.
Spread the rice in a baking dish and add the mushrooms and cannellini beans.
Pour over the hot vegetable stock and cream with the thyme.
Cover and bake at 180C for 40 minutes, then uncover for 10 minutes until golden on top.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the garlic butter up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; bake the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat, and cook the cauliflower steaks fresh

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brush with the oil and season with the smoked paprika and salt.
Sear the cauliflower steaks hard in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side, then finish in the oven with the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Put a slice of garlic butter on each cauliflower steak.
Split the potatoes and load with sour cream and chives.

veg.n: Lemon thyme haloumi with baby potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Toss the potatoes with half the olive oil and the salt and roast at 200C for 35 minutes.
Toss the haloumi with the lemon juice, thyme and the rest of the oil.
Fry the haloumi in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Steam the beans and toss with the potatoes, haloumi and butter.

veg.n: Airbase cauliflower steak, corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Make the slaw up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; cut and grill the cauliflower steaks and corn on the night

steps.text: Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and brush with the olive oil, smoked paprika and salt.
Grill the cauliflower steaks and corn over medium high heat, turning, until charred and tender.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with corn and slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and quarter the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil, then soften the onion and carrots in the same pot.
Stir in the tomato paste, soy sauce, miso, thyme, lentils and stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 1 hour until the lentils are soft and the gravy is thick.
Peel and boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook fast and build the rolls just before serving

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms as thin as you can.
Fry the onions in 1 tbsp of the oil until soft, then push to the side.
Add the rest of the oil and the mushrooms and cook fast on high heat until browned, then add the soy sauce, salt and pepper and toss with the onions.
Lay the provolone over the top to melt and pile into split rolls.

veg.n: "I must break you" mushroom and potato pelmeni
veg.make_ahead: Freeze uncooked dumplings for up to 1 month

steps.text: Mix the flour, egg and water into a firm dough, knead and rest under a bowl.
Boil the potatoes until soft and mash. Grate the onion and fry with the mushrooms in 20 g of the butter until dry, then mix into the potato with salt and pepper and cool.
Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal each one.
Boil in salted water until they float and are cooked through.
Toss in the rest of the butter and the dill and serve with sour cream.

veg.n: Harold's tax audit mushroom and leek pot pie
veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom and bean filling up to 2 days ahead and chill; top with pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms with the sliced leeks in the butter until golden.
Stir in the flour, the vegetable stock, the cream and the cannellini beans and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Chop the tomatoes with the onion and vinegar for the vinaigrette.
Toast the cassava flour in the butter until golden and nutty.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brush with the olive oil and salt and grill over high heat until charred and tender.
Warm the beans. Serve the cauliflower steaks with farofa, beans and the vinaigrette.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the shiitake and fry the tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; make the broth, eggs and noodles on the night

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slices

steps.text: Soak the shiitake in 250 ml hot water for 20 minutes, then slice, keeping the soaking water.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then add the soy sauce, brown sugar and 3 tbsp water and simmer until sticky.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Simmer the vegetable stock with the shiitake and soaking water for 10 minutes, then whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build the bowls with tofu, eggs, nori and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: portobello mushrooms, cut into thick chunks

steps.text: Brown the portobello chunks in batches in the olive oil.
Add the button mushrooms and smoked paprika and cook until golden.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour, then pour in the red wine and stock and add the thyme.
Simmer gently for 45 minutes until tender and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the mushrooms.

ingredients.item: portobello mushrooms, cut into thick chunks

steps.text: Brown the portobello chunks in batches in the olive oil.
Add the button mushrooms and smoked paprika and cook until golden.
Stir in the tomato paste and flour, then pour in the water, red wine vinegar and stock and add the thyme.
Simmer gently for 45 minutes until tender and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the mushrooms.

veg.n: Manor roast cauliflower and Yorkshire pudding
veg.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil whole in salted water for 8 minutes and drain well.
Rub with the melted butter and sea salt flakes and roast at 200C until deep golden, basting now and then.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in some of the oil alongside.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C until puffed.
Reduce the red wine with the mushroom stock for a jus and cut the cauliflowers into wedges.

veg_af.n: Manor roast cauliflower and Yorkshire pudding (alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil whole in salted water for 8 minutes and drain well.
Rub with the melted butter and sea salt flakes and roast at 200C until deep golden, basting now and then.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in some of the oil alongside.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C until puffed.
Reduce the mushroom stock with the water and red wine vinegar for a jus and cut the cauliflowers into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water and blitz.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil until dark and dry.
Add the chillies, cumin, garlic, tomatoes, both beans, soy sauce and water.
Simmer gently for 45 minutes until thick.
Bake the cornbread in a skillet and serve with the chilli.

veg.make_ahead: Score and rub the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the night and make the slaw just before serving

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and score the cut sides in a criss cross.
Rub the mushrooms with the oil, paprika, garlic, sugar and salt.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C, turning once, until a dark sticky crust forms.
Grill the corn, brush with butter, and toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for a slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Thread the skewers up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 3 for the marinade and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Toss the haloumi, zucchini and capsicum in the lemon juice, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oregano and oil.
Leave to marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill hot until charred.
Mix the yoghurt with the grated cucumber and the last garlic clove, crushed.
Serve in warm pita with tomato and red onion.

veg.n: Amish mushroom and noodles over mash
veg.make_ahead: Simmer the mushroom broth up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat, add the beans and noodles and make the mash on the night

ingredients.item: salt and white pepper, to taste

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in 30 g of the butter in a large pot.
Add the vegetable stock with the diced onion, the diced carrots and the celery sticks and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the butter beans and the wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens.
Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper.
Meanwhile boil the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with the rest of the butter and the milk.
Ladle the mushrooms and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.

veg.n: Mandrake Falls smoky capsicum mushroom pizza
veg.make_ahead: Fry the capsicums and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Divide the dough in two and stretch each into a round on oiled trays. Spread with pizza sauce.
Fry the mushrooms with the garlic in a little of the oil.
Fry the capsicums in the rest of the oil with the smoked paprika until soft.
Top the bases with mozzarella, capsicum and mushrooms.
Bake at 240C until blistered.
Scatter with oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.

veg.n: Nice Guy Eddie's portobello steak sandwich
veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions and mix the horseradish mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; sear the mushrooms and build on the night

steps.text: Cook the sliced onions slowly in the butter until golden.
Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and sear in the olive oil, pressing down, until browned and tender.
Mix the mayonnaise and horseradish and toast the rolls.
Slice the mushrooms and pile into rolls with onions and provolone.

veg.n: Campfire mushroom and black bean patties
veg.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the beans and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, egg, salt and pepper. Shape into thick patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry the onions in 1 tbsp of the oil until soft and sweet.
Cook the patties in the rest of the oil on a hot plate over the coals or in a smoking pan, turning once carefully.
Serve between thick slices of white bread with the onions and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil base up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; top with fresh mash and bake on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion, grate the carrots, chop the mushrooms and peel the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms with the onion and carrot in the oil, add the tomato paste, soy sauce, lentils, peas and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.
Spread the lentils in a dish and top with mash.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.n: Big Jeff's mushroom and haloumi burger
veg.make_ahead: Trim the mushrooms and prep the toppings up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; griddle and build just before serving

steps.text: Trim the mushroom stems. Prep the lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season and griddle on a hot surface, pressing down, until tender.
Griddle the haloumi until golden, sit a slice on each mushroom, lay cheddar on top and cover with a lid until melted.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with all the toppings.

veg.make_ahead: Blitz the peas and spinach puree up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; cook the risotto fresh

steps.text: Heat the stock, grate the cheese and blitz the peas and spinach with a splash of stock until smooth.
Stir the rice in some of the butter, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time.
Stir through the green puree, the rest of the butter and the cheese until bright green.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the tofu and simmer the coconut sauce up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; steam the rice to serve

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slabs

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass, slice the chilli and pat the tofu dry.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden on both sides.
Simmer the lemongrass and chilli in the coconut milk with the soy sauce.
Add the tofu and simmer gently.
Steam the rice.
Squeeze in lime juice and serve over the rice with fresh herbs.

veg.n: Fatso's smoky mushroom and corn chowder in bread bowls
veg.make_ahead: Simmer the chowder up to the potato stage 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; stir in the cream and corn and fill the loaves on the night

steps.text: Dice the mushrooms, onion, celery and potatoes.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter with the smoked paprika until dark and smoky.
Add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Add the potatoes, stock, nori and milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream and corn. Hollow out and toast the cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.

veg.n: Pancakes, smoky mushrooms and scrambled eggs
veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and make the batter up to 4 hours ahead; cook everything just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 2 of the eggs and the buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in a buttered pan and keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the butter with the smoked paprika and soy sauce until crisp at the edges.
Scramble the remaining eggs softly.
Slice the strawberries.
Pile everything onto big plates with the maple syrup on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a large pan.
Add the onion, carrots, tomato paste, soy sauce, lentils and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and milk.
Spread the lentils in a dish, top with mash and bake at 200C until golden.

veg.n: Isla Nublar chilli lime haloumi and beans
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, 2 for the marinade and 1 for the salsa

steps.text: Marinate the haloumi in the juice of 2 limes, the garlic, chilli and oil for 20 minutes.
Grill the haloumi over high heat until charred on both sides. Cook the rice at the same time.
Warm the beans with the cumin, paprika and salt.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and a squeeze of the last lime for the salsa. Serve the haloumi over rice and beans with the salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sage butter up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkin, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Mash 60 g of the butter with half the sage and rub it over the cut side of the pumpkin.
Roast cut side up at 180C until tender and golden.
Fry the onion and celery in a little butter, crumble in the cornbread and mix with the rest of the sage, the egg and 150 ml of the stock. Bake in a dish for the last 30 minutes of roasting.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange zest.
Melt the last of the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the remaining stock and the pumpkin tray juices and simmer into gravy.

veg.n: Don Corrado's baked ziti with fennel mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; add 10 minutes to the bake

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the fennel seeds and chilli flakes until browned and dry.
Add the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the passata, water and oregano and simmer gently, stirring.
Boil the ziti for 2 minutes less than the packet time and drain. Mix the ricotta with the seasoning.
Layer pasta, sugo, ricotta and mozzarella in an ovenproof dish.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered and rest for 10 minutes.

veg.n: Courtside mushroom and ricotta meatball subs
veg.make_ahead: Meatballs up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, cheese and salt and roll into 16 balls.
Bake on an oiled tray at 200C until browned.
Simmer the meatballs gently in the crushed tomatoes.
Pile into split rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until bubbly. Finish with basil.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu batons in some of the soy sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and slice the shiitake and vegetables; stir-fry to order

steps.text: Cut the tofu into batons and toss with some of the soy sauce.
Slice the shiitake and prep the cabbage and carrot.
Stir-fry the tofu in a smoking wok with the oil until golden, then add the shiitake.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry briefly.
Add the udon, mushroom oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce and wine and toss until glossy.
Finish with spring onion.

veg_af.make_ahead: Toss the tofu in some of the soy sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, and slice the shiitake and vegetables; stir-fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the tofu into batons and toss with some of the soy sauce.
Slice the shiitake and prep the cabbage and carrot.
Stir-fry the tofu in a smoking wok with the oil until golden, then add the shiitake.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry briefly.
Add the udon, mushroom oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce, stock and rice vinegar and toss until glossy.
Finish with spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sage butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Mix the butter with chopped sage and rub over the pumpkin. Roast cut side up at 180C for 40 minutes, with the potatoes tossed in the oil in the same tray.
Make up the stuffing mix as the packet says, pack it into the pumpkin hollows and roast another 30 minutes.
Pour the tray butter into a small pan, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Boil and mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat with a splash of milk; brown the sausages and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Brown the vegetarian sausages slowly in the oil for 12 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and the milk.
Fry the sliced onions in the sausage pan until soft, stir in the flour, the stock and the soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Serve the sausages on mash with gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

ingredients.item: lemon, juiced, for the pan sauce
lemon, cut into wedges, for serving

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and crush lightly.
Pan fry the haloumi in the oil until golden and crisp on both sides.
Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan and spoon over the haloumi.
Serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Army mess hall mushroom and bean stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in oil.
Add the vegetables, tomato paste, soy sauce and flour, then the stock, and simmer for 40 minutes until thick and tender.
Add the butter beans for the last 10 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflowers up to 4 hours ahead and keep them covered; roast and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Mix the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, chilli and salt with the oil and rub all over the cauliflowers.
Roast covered at 200C for 30 minutes, then uncover, scatter the chickpeas around and roast 30 minutes more until charred and tender.
Steep the saffron in hot water and cook the basmati rice with it until golden and fluffy.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the pancake batter and slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook everything on the night

steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, one egg and buttermilk into a batter and rest.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika over medium heat until crisp at the edges and keep warm.
Cook small pancakes in half the butter until bubbles set and both sides are golden.
Fry four eggs in the mushroom pan until the whites are set.
Toast the bread and butter with the remaining butter.
Warm small slices of pie at 180C.
Bring everything to the table at once, with maple syrup for the pancakes.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead and keep in cold water

steps.text: Cut the potatoes thin and fry in the vegetable oil at 140C, drain, then fry at 185C until crisp.
Season the portobellos with salt and pepper and sear hard in the olive oil in cast iron, pressing down, until browned and tender.
Crush the peppercorns in the pan, flame the brandy, add the cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the butter and serve over the mushrooms with the frites.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead and keep in cold water

steps.text: Cut the potatoes thin and fry in the vegetable oil at 140C, drain, then fry at 185C until crisp.
Season the portobellos with salt and pepper and sear hard in the olive oil in cast iron, pressing down, until browned and tender.
Crush the peppercorns in the pan, add the stock and vinegar and bubble for a minute, add the cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the butter and serve over the mushrooms with the frites.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the chipotles, drain the beans and dice the sweet potato.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in oil.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and water and simmer.
Add the beans for the last stretch of cooking.
Serve with sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Pumpkin and stuffing up to 1 day ahead, reheat to serve

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1cm rounds

steps.text: Toss the pumpkin with the oil, salt and sage and roast at 200C until golden and tender.
Make the stuffing mix with the packet water amount, spread in a small dish and bake beside the pumpkin, then cut into squares.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, whisk in the stock and simmer for gravy.
Fill the buns with pumpkin, cranberry sauce, stuffing squares and a spoonful of gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the swede up to 1 day ahead and reheat; the portobellos and sauce are cooked fresh

steps.text: Roast the potatoes with 2 tbsp of the oil and some salt at 200C until golden and crisp.
Boil the swede until soft, drain and mash with 50 g of the butter.
Rub the portobellos with juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear in the rest of the oil and butter until browned and tender, then lift out.
Add the whisky, redcurrant jelly, stock and soy sauce to the pan and reduce to a glossy sauce.
Slice the portobellos and serve with the mash, potatoes and sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Make the swede mash up to 1 day ahead and reheat with the butter; roast the potatoes, sear the portobellos and reduce the sauce on the night

steps.text: Roast the potatoes with 2 tbsp of the oil and some salt at 200C until golden and crisp.
Boil the swede until soft, drain and mash with 50 g of the butter.
Rub the portobellos with juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear in the rest of the oil and butter until browned and tender, then lift out.
Add the apple juice, vinegar, redcurrant jelly, stock and soy sauce to the pan and reduce to a glossy sauce.
Slice the portobellos and serve with the mash, potatoes and sauce.

veg.n: Joined-tables crisp tofu with caper butter
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush with some of the oil and salt.
Pat the tofu dry, dust with the cornflour, salt and pepper and fry in a hot oiled pan until crisp on both sides.
Wipe the pan, melt the butter until it foams brown, then add the capers, most of the lemon juice and the parsley.
Toss the rocket with the cheese, the last of the oil and lemon.
Plate the tofu on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and soften.
Stir in the flour, cream, thyme, peas and cannellini beans and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and egg wash.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

veg.n: Rainy night mushroom and bean stew
veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the sliced onion, crushed garlic and crumbled chillies.
Pour in the tomatoes, soy sauce and water.
Braise at 160C for 40 minutes.
Add the kidney beans for the last 20 minutes.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and chop the kimchi. Put the rice on to cook.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned, then add the kimchi, garlic and gochugaru.
Pour in the water and soy sauce and simmer.
Add sliced tofu and spring onion and simmer for the last few minutes. Serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the potato layers up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear and roast the portobellos and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer with cream, salt and pepper in a dish and bake at 180C until tender.
Season the portobellos and sear hard in the oil and 40 g of the butter.
Roast at 200C for 8 minutes until tender.
Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock, reduce until glossy and whisk in the rest of the butter.
Char the asparagus and serve with the portobellos and sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Bake the potato layers up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear and roast the portobellos and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer with cream, salt and pepper in a dish and bake at 180C until tender.
Season the portobellos and sear hard in the oil and 40 g of the butter.
Roast at 200C for 8 minutes until tender.
Deglaze the pan with the water, red wine vinegar and stock, reduce until glossy and whisk in the rest of the butter.
Char the asparagus and serve with the portobellos and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, slice before serving

steps.text: Brush the mushrooms with the Dijon and oil and season with the pepper and salt.
Roast at 200C until tender and juicy.
Rest, then slice thick.
Stir the horseradish into the sour cream.
Split the rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with mushrooms, rocket and pickled onions.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the mushrooms rest; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry in the neutral oil at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the portobellos and sear hard in the olive oil for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan, add the wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp.
Slice the mushrooms and spoon the sauce over.

veg_af.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the mushrooms rest; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry in the neutral oil at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the portobellos and sear hard in the olive oil for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan, add the stock and vinegar and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp.
Slice the mushrooms and spoon the sauce over.

veg.n: Cooper Station mushroom and corn pie
veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom filling up to 1 day ahead, cool and chill; top with the pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in half the butter until golden and lift out.
Soften the leek in the rest of the butter.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream.
Add the mushrooms, corn and thyme.
Tip into a dish and top with the pastry.
Bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

veg.n: Last of the V8s highway mushroom pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms and onion in the oil in batches.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the stock, soy sauce and lentils and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling.
Line four pie tins with shortcrust and fill.
Top with puff and bake at 200C.
Add tomato sauce on top.

veg.n: Trinity test green chilli and bean stew
veg.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead in the fridge, adding the cannellini beans as you reheat; warm the tortillas to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then soften the diced onion and the garlic cloves.
Char the large green chillies, peel, chop and add with the diced potatoes, the cumin and the vegetable stock.
Simmer 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the cannellini beans for the last 10 minutes.
Serve with the warm flour tortillas.

veg.make_ahead: Dressing and slaw up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toss the smoked tofu with the coriander, pepper and smoked paprika and fry in the oil until crisp at the edges.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish and pickle for Russian dressing.
Toss the coleslaw mix with half the dressing.
Fill the rolls with tofu, Swiss cheese, slaw and the rest of the dressing.

veg.n: Captain Stacy's red wine braised mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the portobellos in the oil and lift out, then soften the onions in the same pot.
Add the lentils, wine, stock and tomato paste.
Braise covered at 160C for 25 minutes.
Halve the carrots, sit them and the portobellos on top of the lentils, cover and braise another 30 minutes.
Slice the portobellos thick and serve over the lentils and carrots.
Brown the portobellos in the oil and lift out, then soften the onions in the same pot.
Add the lentils, water, red wine vinegar, stock and tomato paste.
Braise covered at 160C for 25 minutes.
Halve the carrots, sit them and the portobellos on top of the lentils, cover and braise another 30 minutes.
Slice the portobellos thick and serve over the lentils and carrots.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the garlic butter up to 3 days ahead, chilled; fry the chips the first time up to 2 hours ahead, then finish the chips and sear the cauliflower on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips. Mash the butter with the garlic.
Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at 140C until soft and pale.
Fry again at 185C until crisp.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season and sear hard in the olive oil, then cover and cook until tender.
Top each with a slice of garlic butter.

veg.make_ahead: Meatballs up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, egg, breadcrumbs, some of the cheese and the parsley. Roll into balls and chill.
Brown the meatballs in the rest of the oil.
Simmer the meatballs gently in the tomatoes for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and more cheese, and save a plate for the toys.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cucumber and spring onions up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast the mushrooms just before serving so they stay crisp

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, soy sauce, five spice and salt and roast at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Cut the cucumber and spring onions into matchsticks.
Steam the pancakes.
Serve the mushrooms with the pancakes, vegetables and hoisin for rolling at the table.

veg.n: Tollbooth shift smashed mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Prep the lettuce, tomatoes and pickles up to 4 hours ahead and brush the mushrooms and haloumi with oil and paprika up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; cook everything on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips and onion rings at 220C until crisp.
Brush the mushrooms and haloumi with the oil and smoked paprika.
Cook the mushrooms in a very hot pan, smashing them flat with a spatula, then flip and top with the cheddar.
Fry the haloumi until golden on both sides and toast the buns.
Set out the lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.

veg.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; crush the garlic and measure out the butter and lemon myrtle up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply in a criss cross and brush with the oil and salt.
Grill cut side down over medium high heat until charred, then flip and cook until soft right through.
Melt the butter with the garlic and lemon myrtle, spoon over the eggplant and serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the nut roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: plain flour, 150g for the batter and 20g for the gravy
eggs, 3 for the batter and 2 for the roast

steps.text: Whisk 150 g of the flour, 3 eggs and the milk into a batter and rest it.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then mix with the lentils, nuts, breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, cheddar, thyme and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Roast the nut roast at 200C for 45 minutes until firm and browned.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in 2 tbsp of the oil alongside.
Rest the nut roast. Heat the rest of the oil in muffin tins.
Pour in the batter and bake.
Melt the butter, stir in the rest of the flour, whisk in the stock and the rest of the soy sauce and simmer for gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; loosen with a splash of water when reheating as the barley thickens it

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the onion, the carrots and the parsnips in chunks, the pearl barley, thyme, soy sauce and the stock.
Cover and simmer 50 minutes until the barley is plump and the vegetables are tender.
Serve in big bowls with the bread.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil and mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; fill and bake the capsicums on the day and mix the garlic yoghurt fresh

ingredients.item: garlic cloves (2 for the filling, 1 for the yoghurt)

steps.text: Fry the onion and two of the garlic cloves in the oil, add the mushrooms and brown.
Stir in the lentils, rice, both paprikas, salt and a little water and cook briefly.
Cut the tops off the capsicums, remove the seeds and fill.
Stand in a dish, pour around the passata mixed with water and bake covered at 180C.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining crushed garlic. Serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Soak the glass noodles in hot water and drain.
Cube the tofu and slice the carrots and onion. Crush the garlic and chop the ginger.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, add the garlic and ginger, then the carrots and onion.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and water and toss until the noodles soak it all up.

veg.n: Ruettiger family Sunday mushroom pot roast
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Quarter the onions, peel the carrots and halve the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a heavy pot and lift out.
Add the onions, garlic, tomato paste, stock, soy sauce, thyme, bay leaves, carrots and potatoes. Cover and cook at 160C for 40 minutes.
Sit the mushrooms on top and cook another 20 minutes.
Thicken the juices with the cornflour mixed with a little water.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish cream and serve with the crusty loaf.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in the buttermilk and salt for 1 hour.
Mix the flour with the paprika and pepper and dredge the cauliflower in it.
Fry at 175C in the oil in batches until deep golden and tender.
Boil the potatoes and mash with 30 g of the butter and the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in 2 tbsp of the seasoned flour and whisk in the stock to make gravy.

veg.n: Man village paneer and chickpea curry
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Cube the paneer and grate the ginger and garlic.
Soften the ginger and garlic in the oil.
Add the garam masala and fry for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes, then add the paneer for 5 minutes.
Cook the basmati rice according to the packet.
Warm the naan and serve with the curry and rice.

veg.make_ahead: Can rest, covered, for 30 minutes

steps.text: Boil the cauliflowers whole for 8 minutes and drain. Cut slits and push in the garlic and rosemary, then rub with the lemon, salt and half the oil.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes in the rest of the oil until deep golden.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint.
Cut the cauliflowers into wedges to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the tofu in the cider up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; boil and mash the potatoes fresh

ingredients.item: smoked tofu, cut into 8 thick slabs

steps.text: Brown the tofu in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and apples with the sage.
Pour in the cider, return the tofu and simmer until the sauce reduces.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cook the tofu in the apple juice up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; boil and mash the potatoes fresh

ingredients.item: smoked tofu, cut into 8 thick slabs

steps.text: Brown the tofu in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and apples with the sage.
Pour in the apple juice and vinegar, return the tofu and simmer until the sauce reduces.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
